property: Successful committed transactions remain present and database contents/integrity match the sequential transactional specification after concurrent checkpoint/write activity and normal reopen.
method: Use independently recorded transaction IDs/values and legal transactional ordering, full table comparison plus PRAGMA integrity_check after checkpoint and reopen. Integrity_check alone can miss lost logical updates.
witness_requirements: Checkpoint header generation, writer reset/generation, native shared-memory identities and lock transitions, checkpoint backfill publication, committed input table and recovered table mismatch.
